title: instructions.yaml
description: JSON Schema for instructions.yaml gate files. Defines the structure of a document's gate sequence, validation rules, and completion condition. See ADR-004 (type vocabulary) and ADR-005 (validation_rules vocabulary).

document.description: Kebab-case document identifier matching the template pack folder name.

gates.description: Ordered sequence of gates. Each gate is a question or check the agent must complete before moving on.

gate.description: A single gate — one question or elicitation step in the document-filling sequence.

id.description: Snake-case identifier for this gate. Must be unique within the document.

order.description: Execution order. Gates run in ascending order; earlier gates must be resolved before later ones.

type.description: Gate output type from the ADR-004 controlled vocabulary. Declares the rendering shape of the gate's output.

prompt.description: The question or instruction the agent presents to the user.

fills.description: The template section or placeholder this gate populates (e.g. '## Project Definition / Background').

maps_to.description: Ontology property this gate's output maps to, as a CURIE (e.g. dct:title, pm:hasSponsor).

required.description: Whether this gate must be filled before the document is considered draft-complete.

deferred_value.description: Placeholder text inserted when the gate is skipped. Required when required is false.

validation.description: Human-readable rule the agent checks before accepting the user's answer.

validation_rules.description: Machine-readable constraint block supplementing the prose validation field. See ADR-005.

guidance.description: Extra instruction to the agent that is not shown to the user.

then.errorMessage: Gates with required: false must include a deferred_value placeholder.

validation_rules.description: Programmatically checkable constraint keys. At least one key must be present. See ADR-005.

unique.description: Value must not be reused across entries in the same register.

allowed_values.description: Value must be exactly one of the listed options.

min_items.description: Output must contain at least this many discrete, enumerable items.

named_individual.description: Value must be a specific named person; a role, team, or department name alone is insufficient.

required_parts.description: Structured output must explicitly address each named part (e.g. [cause, event, impact]).

format.description: Format constraint on the gate value.

references_document.description: Output must reference or be consistent with this sibling document (kebab-case document ID).

completion.description: Completion condition: the agent must not mark a document draft-complete until all required_gates are filled.

required_gates.description: Gate ids that must be non-empty for the document to be draft-complete.

output_status.description: Status assigned to the document when all required gates are filled.

next_document.description: Kebab-case id of the document to produce next, or null if this is the last document in the phase.
